CFML Language Reference: Functions

Wrap

Breaks a string into lines at word boundaries so that no line is longer than the specified number of characters, inserting line-feed characters.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Wrap(string, limit [, strip ])

Parameters

string
The text to wrap.
limit
Maximum number of characters per line.
strip
Optional. Boolean. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it and always keeps existing line breaks.

Returns

The wrapped text, with lines separated by line feeds (Chr(10)).

Usage

Spaces at the break points are dropped. A single word longer than limit is placed on a line of its own rather than being cut. Wrapping matters most for plain-text CFMAIL messages, which some mail readers display in one very long line otherwise. Show the result in a browser inside PRE tags.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Text = "KoldFusion makes it easy to build dynamic Web applications that run equally well on a 56K modem and a T1 line.">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Wrapped at 30 characters:</P>
<PRE>#Wrap(Text, 30)#</PRE>
<P>Wrapped at 50 characters:</P>
<PRE>#Wrap(Text, 50)#</PRE>
</CFOUTPUT>
